title: Minotaur and Fox Spirit
description: A massive purple muscular minotaur with blue hair and horns roars while breaking chains in a ruined stone archway, surrounded by pink hearts and purple energy. In the foreground, a female fox spirit with white and blue tails runs forward, casting colorful flames and purple heart magic from her hands.
prompt: A powerful purple muscular minotaur with blue flowing hair and large horns roars with an open mouth while breaking heavy metal chains, surrounded by floating pink hearts and purple energy effects. In the foreground a beautiful female fox spirit with multiple white and blue glowing tails runs dynamically, wearing a revealing white and gold outfit, casting colorful magical flames and glowing purple hearts from her hands, set in a dramatic ruined stone archway with flying debris and rays of light breaking through dramatic clouds.
